name: nightcal
description: Downtown night calendar. A2UI v0.9 custom catalog. Dynamic properties are either a literal or {"path": "/json/pointer"} into the surface data model.

action.description: Action with event.name and optional context.

Marquee.description: The month, set like a theater marquee over the sheet.

VenueRail.description: The rooms on the trunk. Clicking one filters the calendar to that room.

venues.description: Dynamic value. Array of {id, name, music, address, osm}.

selected.description: DynamicString. Venue id, or empty for every room.

NightCalendar.description: A month module. A host sets view to {tilt, depth, bars, focus, suspended} and the sheet follows: tilt is how far the sheet tips, in degrees from 0 to 24; depth is how close the strongest show sits, in px from 0 to 24; bars draws every show against that same strongest score; focus is how much larger the focused day is, from 1 to 1.6; suspended drops the paper so the month hangs on neon wire. The house default hangs the month, tips it 22 degrees, lifts the strongest show 16px, draws the bars, and makes the focused day a fifth larger. vote is dispatched with context.eventId and context.direction (up or down).

view.description: Dynamic value. Host preference {tilt, depth, bars, focus, suspended}. Missing fields use the house default.

vote.description: Dispatched with context.eventId and context.direction, up or down.
